points.description: Gives one valid reason for charge on colloidal surfaces (e.g. ionisation of surface groups like OH/COOH depending on pH; imperfection/isomorphous substitution in crystal structure; adsorption of ions onto the surface).
points.partial_credit: Half mark if the reason is vaguely stated but clearly on the right track (e.g. 'ionisation' or 'ions' with no detail).

points.description: Gives a second, different valid reason from the same set (ionisation of active sites; crystal imperfection/substitution; adsorption of anions/ions).
points.partial_credit: Half mark if vague but on the right track.

rubric.notes: Full marks for any two different valid reasons from the model answer (ionisation of surface groups, crystal imperfection, adsorption of ions), in any wording. Give part marks for vague but relevant reasons. Give no marks for unrelated reasons; a wrong extra remark does not cost marks if two valid reasons are given. Two wordings of the same reason count once.
